name: Vinson Knight
role: Bishop at Kirtland, Missouri, and Nauvoo
dateNote: He was baptized in spring 1834 and became a bishop at Commerce in 1839; section 124 dates from January 1841.
importance: He served as counselor to Bishop Newel K. Whitney in Kirtland and as acting bishop at Adam-ondi-Ahman. In Illinois he helped buy land for the Saints and became a bishop at Commerce. Section 124 invites him to put stock into the Nauvoo House. It also names him with Samuel H. Smith and Shadrach Roundy to preside over a bishopric.
connections: He married Martha McBride in 1826. He worked under Newel K. Whitney and with Samuel H. Smith.

sources.title: Vinson Knight, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 14 Mar. 1804, Norwich, Massachusetts; living in Perrysburg, New York, by 1830; baptized spring 1834; counselor to Whitney Jan. 1836; acting bishop Adam-ondi-Ahman June 1838; bishop at Commerce 1839; died 31 July 1842, Nauvoo (date partly cut off on the page, confirmed by its citations).
